findings.fix: Delete `FDRep.simpleObjects` and write `SimpleFDRepClasses k G := Skeleton (Simple : ObjectProperty (FDRep k G)).FullSubcategory`, and register the closure once in general: `instance {C} [Category C] [HasZeroMorphisms C] : (Simple : ObjectProperty C).IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms := ⟨fun e h => have := h; Simple.of_iso e.symm⟩`.
findings.issue: `abbrev FDRep.simpleObjects k G : ObjectProperty (FDRep k G) := fun X => Simple X` is an eta-expanded alias for `CategoryTheory.Simple`: `ObjectProperty C` is `abbrev ObjectProperty (C) := C → Prop` (mathlib Mathlib/CategoryTheory/ObjectProperty/Basic.lean:34), so `(Simple : ObjectProperty (FDRep k G))` already is this property. The `IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms` instance on line 67 is likewise `Simple.of_iso` (mathlib Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Simple.lean:68), which holds in any `[Category C] [HasZeroMorphisms C]`, restricted to `FDRep`.

summary: The dictionary, the skeleton type and the classification statements are genuinely absent from Mathlib and from this repository, and reuse of `Rep.equivalenceModuleMonoidAlgebra`, `simple_iff_isSimpleModule`, `Functor.simple_of_simple_obj` and `CategoryTheory.Skeleton` is correct. Three declarations/proofs re-derive existing API: `FDRep.simpleObjects` aliases `CategoryTheory.Simple`, and two `Subrepresentation.subtype` lemmas reprove `Submodule` lemmas by hand.
